title: First variation of a vertical field ζ·e
statement: Let m, n ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝᵐ, R = (M, θ, ξ_R) an integer multiplicity triple in U (IMRep U n) with μ := R.measure = θHⁿ⌞M, let ζ : ℝᵐ → ℝ be differentiable at every point, and e ∈ ℝᵐ. Let p_x be the orthogonal projection onto approxTangentPlane n M x. Then R.firstVariation (x ↦ ζ(x)e) = ∫ Dζ(x)(p_x e) dμ(x), both sides being Bochner integrals (no integrability assumption).
lean_statement: ∀ (m n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid m)) (R : IMRep U n) (ζ : Euclid m → ℝ) (e : Euclid m), Differentiable ℝ ζ → R.firstVariation (fun x => ζ x • e) = ∫ x, fderiv ℝ ζ x ((approxTangentPlane n R.carrier x).starProjection e) ∂R.measure
